xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3324

plan.title: bug(engine,deposit): consumer deposits present as buildable source - check-family verbs fall through to the corepack/pnpm self-build path; deposit marker should force global-CLI dispatch for all verbs (#3282 residual)

narratives.Description: Add a consumer-deposit marker (file or package.json field). When present, engine:invoke never takes the buildable-source/self-build path: resolve global CLI for every verb; if missing, fail closed with npm i -g @deftai/directive (exit 2). Runtime-verb whitelist remains for true source checkouts. Do not change what check composes (#3284). Pin a test for the marker branch. Cite #3324. Refs #3282 #20
narratives.Overview: Consumer deposits that look like buildable source (package.json plus a build script, no CLI dist) must not take the self-build path. Add a deposit marker. When it is present, engine dispatch resolves the global CLI for every verb and fails closed with the single remediation npm i -g @deftai/directive (exit 2) when the CLI is missing. The runtime-verb whitelist stays for true source checkouts. Out of scope: source-checkout self-build, and what check composes (#3284). Relates #3282 #2022 #1659 #2410.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer-deposit agent, I want every verb to use the global CLI when a deposit marker is present, so that check never bootstraps pnpm to self-build the framework.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add a consumer-deposit marker (file or package.json field). When present, engine:invoke never takes the buildable-source/self-build path: resolve global CLI for every verb; if missing, fail closed with npm i -g @deftai/directive (exit 2). Runtime-verb whitelist remains for true source checkouts. Do not change what check composes (#3284). Pin a test for the marker branch. Cite #3324. Refs #3282 #2022 #1659.

narrative.Acceptance: In a deposit with no local dist and a global CLI, every deft/task deft:* verb uses the global CLI; no corepack/pnpm/build path is reachable.
In a deposit with no global CLI, any verb fails closed with the one remediation string; exit 2.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: tasks/engine-invoke.test.cjs (missing global CLI remediates npm i -g @deftai/directive, exit 2)

narrative.Acceptance: Source checkouts still self-build; a test pins the marker branch; CHANGELOG cites #3324.
